learn.hook: Tick, tock! The train leaves at 7:05. Can you read the clock and not miss it?
points: The short hand shows the hour. The long hand shows the minutes.
The long hand moves from one number to the next in 5 minutes. So at 4 it shows 20 minutes, at 9 it shows 45 minutes.
Between two numbers there are 5 small marks. Each small mark is 1 minute.
Quarter past 6 is 6:15. Half past 6 is 6:30. Quarter to 7 is 6:45.
We write minutes with two digits: 7 o'clock and 5 minutes is 7:05.

example.q: The short hand is between 4 and 5. The long hand is 2 small marks after the 7. What time is it?
steps: Hour: the short hand has passed 4, so the hour is 4.

learn.reallife: We read clocks to catch the school bus, start a cricket match or know when our favourite show begins.

items.q: Long hand on 3: how many minutes past?
Long hand on 6: how many minutes past?
Long hand on 8: how many minutes past?
Long hand on 11: how many minutes past?
Long hand 3 small marks after 2: minutes past?
Long hand on 1: how many minutes past?

quiz.q: The short hand is just past 3 and the long hand is on 4. What time is it?
quiz.explain: The short hand shows 3 o'clock has passed. The long hand on 4 means 4 × 5 = 20 minutes. So it is 3:20.
quiz.mistake: Reads the long hand number as the minutes (3:04) or mixes up the hands

quiz.q: The long hand points to 9. How many minutes past the hour is it?
quiz.explain: Each number on the clock is 5 minutes for the long hand. 9 × 5 = 45 minutes.
quiz.mistake: Reads the number 9 as 9 minutes

quiz.q: What time is 'quarter past 6'?
quiz.explain: A quarter of an hour is 15 minutes. Quarter past 6 is 15 minutes after 6: 6:15.
quiz.mistake: Mixes up quarter past and quarter to

quiz.q: What time is 'half past 11'?
quiz.explain: Half an hour is 30 minutes. Half past 11 is 11:30.
quiz.mistake: Thinks half past means 50 minutes

quiz.q: The clock shows 8:50. How else can we say this time?
quiz.explain: 8:50 is 10 minutes before 9:00, so it is 10 minutes to 9.
quiz.mistake: Uses the hour that has passed instead of the coming hour

quiz.q: How many minutes are there in 1 hour?
quiz.explain: The long hand goes all the way round once in 60 minutes. That is 1 hour.
quiz.mistake: Thinks an hour has 100 minutes, like a metre has 100 cm

quiz.q: The short hand is between 4 and 5. The long hand is 2 small marks after the 7. What time is it?
quiz.explain: The hour is 4. The long hand at 7 means 35 minutes, and 2 more marks make 37. So 4:37.
quiz.mistake: Writes the 7 and the 2 side by side

quiz.q: The train leaves at 7 o'clock and 5 minutes. How do we write this time?
quiz.explain: Minutes are written with two digits. 5 minutes is written as 05, so 7:05.
quiz.mistake: Writes 7:50, which is 50 minutes past 7

teach.ask: Gappu sees the long hand on 4 and says it is 4 minutes past. Is Gappu right?
teach.praise: Thank you! Each number is 5 minutes for the long hand, so 4 means 20 minutes. Gappu reads clocks now!
teach.nudge: How many minutes does the long hand take to go from one number to the next?

topics.title: How long does it take? Time durations

learn.hook: School starts at 8:00 am and ends at 1:30 pm. How long are you in school? Let's count the time!
points: am is for times from midnight to noon (morning). pm is for times from noon to midnight (afternoon and night).
To find how long, count on: first to the next full hour, then the hours, then the minutes.
To find the end time, add the time taken to the start time. If minutes reach 60, change them into 1 hour.

example.q: A cricket match on TV goes from 2:40 pm to 4:10 pm. How long is it?

learn.reallife: We work out how long a train journey takes, or how long we can play before dinner.

quiz.q: School starts at 8:00 am and ends at 1:30 pm. How long is the school day?
quiz.explain: 8:00 am to 12:00 noon is 4 hours. 12:00 to 1:30 pm is 1 hour 30 minutes. Total: 5 hours 30 minutes.
quiz.mistake: Counts from 8 to 1 wrongly by forgetting that 12 comes before 1

quiz.q: How many minutes are there in 2 hours?
quiz.explain: 1 hour = 60 minutes. 2 × 60 = 120 minutes.
quiz.mistake: Thinks 1 hour is 100 minutes

quiz.q: A film starts at 3:15 pm and lasts 2 hours. When does it end?
quiz.explain: Add 2 hours to 3:15 pm: 4:15 pm, then 5:15 pm. It is still afternoon, so pm.
quiz.mistake: Changes pm to am, or adds 2 minutes

quiz.q: Arjun eats breakfast at 7 o'clock in the morning. How do we write this time?
quiz.explain: Morning times before noon use am. So it is 7:00 am.
quiz.mistake: Mixes up am and pm

quiz.q: A cricket match on TV goes from 2:40 pm to 4:10 pm. How long is it?
quiz.explain: 2:40 to 3:00 is 20 minutes, 3:00 to 4:00 is 60 minutes, 4:00 to 4:10 is 10 minutes. 20 + 60 + 10 = 90.
quiz.mistake: Subtracts 410 - 240 like ordinary numbers (gets 170)

quiz.q: Riya sleeps at 9:30 pm and wakes up at 6:30 am. How long does she sleep?
quiz.explain: 9:30 pm to 12:00 midnight is 2 hours 30 minutes. Midnight to 6:30 am is 6 hours 30 minutes. Together: 9 hours.
quiz.mistake: Subtracts 9:30 - 6:30 and forgets the time goes past midnight

quiz.q: How many hours and minutes is 90 minutes?
quiz.explain: 60 minutes make 1 hour. 90 - 60 = 30. So 90 minutes = 1 hour 30 minutes.
quiz.mistake: Thinks 1 hour is 40 minutes or divides by 10

quiz.q: A clock shows 10:45. What time will it be 20 minutes later?
quiz.explain: 10:45 + 15 minutes = 11:00. 5 more minutes makes 11:05.
quiz.mistake: Adds 45 + 20 = 65 and writes 10:65

teach.ask: Gappu's train leaves at 2:40 pm and arrives at 4:10 pm. Gappu did 410 - 240 = 170 minutes. Is that right?
teach.praise: Aha! An hour has 60 minutes, not 100. Count on: 20 + 60 + 10 = 90 minutes!
teach.nudge: How many minutes are in an hour? Try counting on to 3:00 first.

learn.hook: Your birthday is coming! How many days to wait? The calendar knows!
points: A week has 7 days. A year has 12 months.
April, June, September and November have 30 days. February has 28 days (29 in a leap year). All the other months have 31 days.
A year has 365 days. A leap year has 366 days.
The same day of the week comes again every 7 days. If 1 June is a Monday, so are 8, 15, 22 and 29 June.
To count days to a date in the next month, count to the end of this month, then add the days of the next month.

example.q: Today is 28 March. Aisha's birthday is on 5 April. How many days does she have to wait?
steps: March has 31 days. From 28 March to 31 March is 31 - 28 = 3 days.
Then 5 more days to reach 5 April.

learn.reallife: We use calendars to plan holidays, mark exams, count days to Diwali and remember birthdays.

games.title: Calendar facts
items: February gets an extra day, the 29th.
If 1 June is a Monday, then 8 June is also a Monday.
In a year that is not a leap year, February has 28 days.
Only a leap year gives February 29 days.

quiz.q: How many days are there in March?
quiz.explain: March is one of the months with 31 days.
quiz.mistake: Mixes up March with a 30-day month

quiz.q: In a year that is not a leap year, how many days does February have?
quiz.explain: February is the shortest month. It has 28 days, and 29 only in a leap year.
quiz.mistake: Gives the leap-year number of days

quiz.q: How many days are there in a year that is not a leap year?
quiz.explain: An ordinary year has 365 days. A leap year has 366.
quiz.mistake: Thinks every month has 30 days (12 × 30 = 360)

quiz.q: 1 June is a Monday. What day is 8 June?
quiz.explain: 8 June is 7 days after 1 June. The day of the week repeats every 7 days, so it is Monday again.
quiz.mistake: Counts 8 days ahead instead of 7

quiz.q: Today is Friday. What day will it be 3 days from today?
quiz.explain: Count on: Saturday (1), Sunday (2), Monday (3).
quiz.mistake: Counts today as one of the 3 days

quiz.q: How many weeks are there in 28 days?
quiz.explain: Each week has 7 days. 28 ÷ 7 = 4 weeks.
quiz.mistake: Takes away 7 from 28 instead of dividing

quiz.q: Today is 28 March. Aisha's birthday is on 5 April. How many days does she have to wait?
quiz.explain: 28 March to 31 March is 3 days, then 5 more days to 5 April. 3 + 5 = 8 days.
quiz.mistake: Thinks March has 30 days (gets 7)

quiz.q: Which of these months has 30 days?
quiz.explain: April has 30 days. May, January and August each have 31 days.
quiz.mistake: Forgets which months have 30 days

teach.ask: Today is 25 May and Gappu's party is on 2 June. Gappu thinks it's 7 days away. How do we count?
teach.praise: Yes! May has 31 days: 25 to 31 is 6 days, then 2 more makes 8 days. Gappu is excited!
teach.nudge: How many days does May have? Count to the end of May first.
